title: Speaking — Free community events
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on free community events.

questions: What do you enjoy doing when you have an hour to yourself?
Are your hobbies different from when you were younger?
Do your relatives share any of your interests?
Is there a hobby you would like to learn from someone?
What free events take place near where you live?
Do you normally hear about events before they happen?

part2.topic: Describe a public event you enjoyed without paying an entrance fee.
part2.closing: and explain why you would recommend it.

questions: How should local governments judge whether a free festival is worth funding?
What prevents some residents from attending events that are open to everyone?
How has everyday life connected with free community events changed for people of different ages?
